Name: Artifact System Drop Framework and Geodes Handler
Author: pepoluan
Description:
[color=#00ffff][font=Comic Sans MS]This mod's original name was [font=Lucida Sans Unicode][color=#ffff00][b]"Artifact System Fixed - Redux"[/b][/color][/font], and now since I've cleaned up all ASF code, I decide to rename it "Artifact System Drop Framework & Geodes Handler" (ASDFGH for short) because since v0.6.0 it has features to allow other modders to 'patch in' into the Artifact System / Geodes System; please read this doc in its entirety, especially the "FRAMEWORK" section.[/font][/color]

[color=#00ffff]---[/color]

The original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2761]Artifact System Fixed[/url] mod (ASF) aimed to do three things:
[list=1]
[*]Fix the bugged "Primary Table" for artifact spot digging,

[*]Give fairness to odds of items given from artifact spot, and

[*]Reduce the odds of getting same item from "Primary Table" or "Geode drops"
[/list]
Since it was last officially updated, two things happened:
[list=1]
[*]SDV 1.4 came out -- this fixes the "Primary Table" so #1 above is no longer needed, and
[*]SDV 1.5 came out
[/list]
SDV 1.5 introduced A LOT of new things ... that ASF did not take into consideration, such as:
[list]
[*]Qi Beans special order -- totally suppressed by ASF
[*]Bone fragments special order / mail quest -- not suppressed, but made harder
[*]Enchantments are totally ignored
[*]Artifact Troves treated as 'normal' geodes
[*]Golden Coconuts treated as 'normal' geodes
[*]... and many others.
[/list]
Unfortunately, the maker of the original ASF mod seems to have abandoned the mod ([url=https://github.com/Ilyaki/ArtifactSystemFixed/pull/1]PR since last year[/url]﻿ have been ignored)

So I took it upon myself to "[url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/redux]Redux[/url]﻿" this mod.


[font=Trebuchet MS][color=#00ffff][size=5][b]Changes [/b](compared to ASF)[/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][color=#ff0000][size=4][b]Modding Framework[/b][/size][/color] to patch into Artifact System & Geodes System
[*]Fully compatible with SDV 1.5 quests & items
[*]Custom weighting has been taken out, because it's potentially game-breaking due to the much more complex logic of SDV 1.5
[b]Note:[/b] Automatic "de-emphasizing" (i.e., making odds of already-found artifacts to be lower) [i]is kept[/i].[*]"Secondary Table" now also have "fair odds"
[*]If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8680]Even Better RNG (EBRNG)[/url]﻿ version 1.10.0 or newer is used, then it will use EBRNG's much-improved random number generator
[*](since v0.2.0) config.json syntax changes. Older config.json sadly will be overwritten, but in its place
[*](since v0.2.0) MORE configurable knobs in config.json!! Yay!!!
[*](since v0.2.0) Default value for "already found item" is changed to 0.6 to make the mod less 'cheaty' (you can change it back to 0.3 if you want, of course)
[*](since v0.2.0) Default value for "Lost Book found" odds is changed to 0.15 (originally hard-coded to 0.2)
[/list]

[b][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#00ffff][size=5]Installation[/size][/color][/font][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure SMAPI is installed and running
[*]Download & extract to the Mods directory
[*]DELETE the old "Artifact System Fixed" directory (if any)
[*]DELETE the older "Artifact System Fixed - Redux" directory (if any -- since v0.6.0 the directory is called "ASDFGH" <== do NOT delete this one!)

[*]Enjoy
[/list]

[b][i]Remember, delete the old "ASF" and "ASFR" directories![/i][/b]


[b][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#00ffff][size=5]For Mod Makers: [color=#ff00ff]F R A M E W O R K[/color][/size][/color][/font][/b]
The framework is designed to [b]augment[/b] content packs created for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assets[/url] (JA) : If your mod is a valid, working content pack for JA, all you need is to [b]add ONE file[/b] and your mod will now be patched into the Artifact System / Geodes System.

[url=https://sourceforge.net/p/sdvmod-asdfgh/code/ci/default/tree/ASDFGH/docs/mod-authors.md]Please click here to see the documentation for this feature[/url].
